descriptions.w3d_s20_lookup_handle_object_80164fc8: Appears to look up a handle in a slot table of 36-byte entries and return the slot's object when the stored id matches, otherwise null.
descriptions.w3d_s20_get_vector_item_800ffca4: Appears to read an element of a four-byte item vector into the output, returning 0x80004005 when the index is out of range.
descriptions.w3d_s20_init_registry_8016130c: Appears to clear a four-word registry object, publish it in a global and return it.
